exposure: perception of distance from a health facility
cohort: The study included a total weighted sample of 202,029 children aged 12-23 months from 48 resource-limited countries.
finding: The overall incompleteness of basic vaccination among children in resource-limited countries was 51%, and this varied significantly across countries with hotspots identified in Nigeria, Chad, Cameroon, and Niger.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a statistically significant factor associated with incomplete basic vaccination.
country: 48 resource-limited countries (including Nigeria, Chad, Cameroon, Niger for hotspots)
cross-section timing: Recent Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) data, collected considering the era of Millennium Development Goals and Sustainable Development Goals
